definitions.gloss: muddy, covered in mud, mud-covered state
definitions.explanation: The state of being covered in mud, or mud itself (in childish speech). Very common in contexts involving children playing outside.

examples.japanese: どろんこ{遊|あそ}びをする。
{子供|こども}たちがどろんこになって{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing and getting all muddy.

notes:
KANJI: Can be written as {泥|どろ}んこ.

WORD FORMATION: {泥|どろ} (mud) + んこ (emphatic/childish suffix).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どろんこになる (to get muddy)
- どろんこ{遊|あそ}び (mud play)
- どろんこ{道|みち} (muddy road)

NUANCE: Has a playful, childish quality. Often used in the context of children playing outdoors after rain.
